claims.statement: Personal reminder how-to declares FPT/GHEC/GHES wildcard while concept guide declares FPT/GHEC only. This source applicability conflict remains unresolved; no GHES capability is certified from either summary.

Setup navigates personal settings/Integrations and exact organization then Slack workspace authorization. Concept owner-authorization precondition remains; UI authorization instruction does not grant credentials/integration approval.

Shared day selector allows one or more days; time selector one or more times and adjustable timezone. Weekdays/9AM are UI choices/examples not adopted schedule; timezone and daylight-saving behavior require actual verification.

Optional personal or team review-request selections and optional event-specific realtime alerts define reminder scope. Config presence cannot prove full PR inventory or coverage beyond concept five-repository/twenty-PR caps.

Create reminder explicitly activates configuration; optional test sends test reminder. Test output cannot prove recurring scheduled execution, delivery freshness, failure recovery or all selected scopes.

Edit changes exact organization reminder then Update saves. Guide does not supply disable procedure, atomic update guarantee, rollback, retries or durable old-state preservation; these remain unknown.

Deletion explicitly Delete-this-reminder then OK confirmation; no restoration or Slack grant revocation guarantee. Deleting configuration is distinct from disabling, restoring or revoking integration.
No real Slack authorization, recurring process, test message or deletion performed. Native activation needs scoped approval and applicable scheduled-process safeguards.
